actor: Large memory-maker's corporate capital-allocation and capacity-strategy lead
job: Building the internal investment case to raise memory capex and set an AI-era HBM/DRAM capacity target rivals have already committed to.
outcome: Board-approved capex increase or formal AI-memory capacity target ready to disclose.
motivation: Avoid ceding the AI-memory supply narrative to Micron and SK Hynix amid sold-out HBM demand.

task.what: Model HBM/DRAM capex scenarios and capacity targets
task.where: Internal capital-allocation review and board approval process

actor: Large memory-maker's investor-relations and earnings-communications team
job: Preparing the earnings script, filing, or press release that publicly announces the raised memory capex or AI-memory capacity commitment.
outcome: Public announcement - earnings call, filing, or press release - stating the AI-memory capacity/capex commitment.
motivation: Signal a credible capacity path to hyperscaler customers and markets rather than stay conspicuously silent.

task.what: Draft capex-commitment messaging for earnings disclosure
task.where: Quarterly earnings call, regulatory filing, press release
task.why: Publicly commit capacity to hold narrative
task.how: Earnings script, regulatory filing, press release

actor: Large memory-maker's HBM/advanced-DRAM fab and process-engineering team
job: Planning the new or expanded EUV-equipped HBM/DRAM fab or line that gives a public capacity commitment real substance.
outcome: A defined fab/line expansion plan (site, EUV tooling, ramp) backing the announced capacity commitment.
motivation: Ensure sold-out HBM/advanced-DRAM demand can be met and the commitment is executable, not just rhetorical.

task.where: Existing and new fab sites; EUV tool roadmap
task.how: EUV lithography, HBM stacking, fab ramp planning
